## Bar-raiser agent skills v1.0.0

First public release — five installable skills for [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/jakefrompracticelink/agent-skills).

### Highlights

- **bar-raiser-pr-review** — Amazon-style review, test-backed fix loop, full-diff re-review, adversarial merge gate (G-1–G-7)
- **pr-round-reviewer** — read-only independent reviewer for one round
- **design-review** + **design-round-reviewer** — dual-lens design review before code
- **test-first** — behavior-driven TDD discipline for agents

### Install

```bash
npx skills add jakefrompracticelink/agent-skills
```
